notes:
FMC Media PC 0.3.13

- Rich search with a Top match, synopsis, available awards and grouped Movies / Series / Anime results.
- Right-click posters for details, watchlist, local favorites, watched/unwatched and Simkl list/rating actions. Title pages also include a Simkl status menu.
- Simkl writes use a persistent retry queue, verified anime cour numbering and protection against older responses overwriting newer choices.
- Torrent now uses native P2P streaming from peers without a Debrid key. Debrid results stay separate. Authenticated local streaming supports seeking.
- Includes the FebBox Chrome account connector from 0.3.12. Google sign-in stays in the normal browser; the saved connection is reused until the session expires or is disconnected.

Windows only. Local favorites are separate from Simkl; custom named Simkl lists are not exposed by its write API.
Validation: 95 native, 84 source and 38 frontend tests passed; real Windows search/context/status UI inspected. P2P tested between local seed/leecher peers with range seeking.
